relations.name: oltp_upcoming_charge_context_v1
relations.view_definition:
WITH ctx AS (
         SELECT olap_reporting_date() AS t
        ), counts AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(sum(oltp_upcoming_charge_coverage_v1."Recorded Only Loans"), 0::bigint)::integer AS manual_loans,
            COALESCE(sum(oltp_upcoming_charge_coverage_v1."Review Loans"), 0::bigint)::integer AS review_loans
           FROM oltp_upcoming_charge_coverage_v1
        ), orphans AS (
         SELECT count(*)::integer AS n
           FROM "Charges" c
             LEFT JOIN "Loans" l ON l."Row ID" = c."Ref Loans"
             LEFT JOIN "Borrowers" b ON b."Row ID" = l."Ref Borrowers"
          WHERE b."Row ID" IS NULL
        )
 SELECT 'upcoming'::text AS "Row ID",
    ctx.t AS "As Of Date",
    ctx.t + 1 AS "From Date",
    ctx.t + 7 AS "Through Date",
    statement_timestamp() AS "Calculated At",
    (to_char((ctx.t + 1)::timestamp with time zone, 'DD Mon YYYY'::text) || ' - '::text) || to_char((ctx.t + 7)::timestamp with time zone, 'DD Mon YYYY'::text) AS "Date Range",
    (
        CASE
            WHEN (counts.review_loans + orphans.n) > 0 THEN 'Partial forecast - source review required. '::text
            ELSE ''::text
        END ||
        CASE
            WHEN counts.manual_loans > 0 THEN 'Auto-off loans use recorded settlement charges only. '::text
            ELSE ''::text
        END) || 'Projected amounts assume scheduled principal is collected on its due date. Sync to refresh.'::text AS "Forecast Note"
   FROM ctx
     CROSS JOIN counts
     CROSS JOIN orphans;

relations.name: oltp_upcoming_charge_coverage_v1
relations.view_definition:
WITH raw AS MATERIALIZED (
         SELECT i_1.borrower_id,
            i_1.loan_id,
            i_1.reporting_date,
            s.due_date,
            s.origin,
            s.bucket,
            s.principal,
            s.interest,
            s.eligible,
            s.issue
           FROM reporting_forecast_inputs_v1 i_1
             LEFT JOIN LATERAL forecast_schedule_v1(i_1.loan, i_1.charges, i_1.reporting_date, LEAST((i_1.reporting_date + '3 mons'::interval)::date, i_1.reporting_date + 93)) s(due_date, origin, bucket, principal, interest, eligible, issue) ON true
        ), issues AS (
         SELECT raw.borrower_id,
            count(DISTINCT raw.loan_id) FILTER (WHERE raw.origin = 'Notice'::text AND raw.bucket = 'Recorded plan only'::text)::integer AS manual_loans,
            count(DISTINCT raw.loan_id) FILTER (WHERE raw.origin = 'Exception'::text OR raw.origin = 'Recorded'::text AND raw.bucket = 'Recovery only'::text AND raw.due_date > raw.reporting_date)::integer AS review_loans,
            string_agg(DISTINCT raw.issue, '; '::text ORDER BY raw.issue) FILTER (WHERE raw.origin = 'Exception'::text) AS issue_text
           FROM raw
          GROUP BY raw.borrower_id
        ), dates AS (
         SELECT oltp_upcoming_charge_events_v1."Ref Borrower" AS borrower_id,
            count(DISTINCT oltp_upcoming_charge_events_v1."Due Date")::integer AS displayed_dates
           FROM oltp_upcoming_charge_events_v1
          WHERE oltp_upcoming_charge_events_v1."Borrower Due Date Rank" <= 5
          GROUP BY oltp_upcoming_charge_events_v1."Ref Borrower"
        ), ctx AS (
         SELECT olap_reporting_date() AS t
        )
 SELECT b."Row ID",
    b."Row ID" AS "Ref Borrower",
    ctx.t AS "As Of Date",
    LEAST((ctx.t + '3 mons'::interval)::date, ctx.t + 93) AS "Horizon End",
    statement_timestamp() AS "Calculated At",
    COALESCE(d.displayed_dates, 0) AS "Displayed Dates",
    COALESCE(i.manual_loans, 0) AS "Recorded Only Loans",
    COALESCE(i.review_loans, 0) AS "Review Loans",
    ((
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(i.review_loans, 0) > 0 THEN 'Incomplete / review required. '::text
            ELSE ''::text
        END ||
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(d.displayed_dates, 0) = 0 THEN 'No upcoming charges within 3 months.'::text
            ELSE ('Showing '::text || d.displayed_dates) || ' due dates within 3 months.'::text
        END) ||
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(i.manual_loans, 0) > 0 THEN ' Auto-off loans: recorded settlement charges only.'::text
            ELSE ''::text
        END) ||
        CASE
            WHEN i.issue_text IS NOT NULL THEN ' '::text || i.issue_text
            ELSE ''::text
        END AS "Coverage Note"
   FROM "Borrowers" b
     CROSS JOIN ctx
     LEFT JOIN issues i ON i.borrower_id = b."Row ID"
     LEFT JOIN dates d ON d.borrower_id = b."Row ID";

relations.name: oltp_upcoming_charge_events_v1
relations.comment: R048: one loan/date; recorded-first remaining obligations; next seven days union borrower first five dates within three calendar months (max 93 days). Read-only.
relations.view_definition:
WITH raw AS MATERIALIZED (
         SELECT i.loan_id,
            i.borrower_id,
            i.loan,
            i.reporting_date,
            LEAST((i.reporting_date + '3 mons'::interval)::date, i.reporting_date + 93) AS horizon_end,
            s.due_date,
            s.origin,
            s.bucket,
            s.principal,
            s.interest,
            s.eligible,
            s.issue
           FROM reporting_forecast_inputs_v1 i
             JOIN "Borrowers" b ON b."Row ID" = i.borrower_id
             CROSS JOIN LATERAL forecast_schedule_v1(i.loan, i.charges, i.reporting_date, LEAST((i.reporting_date + '3 mons'::interval)::date, i.reporting_date + 93)) s(due_date, origin, bucket, principal, interest, eligible, issue)
        ), amounts AS (
         SELECT raw.loan_id,
            raw.borrower_id,
            raw.reporting_date,
            raw.horizon_end,
            raw.due_date,
            sum(raw.principal) AS principal,
            sum(raw.interest) AS interest,
                CASE
                    WHEN bool_or(raw.origin = 'Recorded'::text) THEN
                    CASE
                        WHEN bool_or(raw.bucket = 'Recovery only'::text) THEN 'Recorded - review status'::text
                        WHEN bool_and(NOT COALESCE((raw.loan ->> 'auto'::text)::boolean, false)) THEN 'Recorded settlement'::text
                        ELSE 'Recorded'::text
                    END
                    ELSE 'Projected'::text
                END AS basis
           FROM raw
          WHERE raw.due_date > raw.reporting_date AND raw.due_date <= raw.horizon_end AND (raw.principal + raw.interest) > 0::numeric AND (raw.origin = 'Recorded'::text OR raw.origin = 'Simulated'::text AND raw.eligible)
          GROUP BY raw.loan_id, raw.borrower_id, raw.reporting_date, raw.horizon_end, raw.due_date
        ), ranked AS (
         SELECT amounts.loan_id,
            amounts.borrower_id,
            amounts.reporting_date,
            amounts.horizon_end,
            amounts.due_date,
            amounts.principal,
            amounts.interest,
            amounts.basis,
            dense_rank() OVER (PARTITION BY amounts.borrower_id ORDER BY amounts.due_date)::integer AS due_rank
           FROM amounts
        )
 SELECT (((('uf1:'::text || length(loan_id)) || ':'::text) || loan_id) || ':'::text) || to_char(due_date::timestamp with time zone, 'YYYY-MM-DD'::text) AS "Row ID",
    borrower_id AS "Ref Borrower",
    loan_id AS "Ref Loan",
    due_date AS "Due Date",
    principal AS "Principal Remaining",
    interest AS "Interest Remaining",
    principal + interest AS "Amount Remaining",
    basis AS "Basis",
    reporting_date AS "As Of Date",
    horizon_end AS "Horizon End",
    statement_timestamp() AS "Calculated At",
    due_date <= (reporting_date + 7) AS "Within 7 Days",
    due_rank AS "Borrower Due Date Rank"
   FROM ranked
  WHERE due_date <= (reporting_date + 7) OR due_rank <= 5;
